name: Bramble Spear
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 1, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target wooden weapon touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none (object); Spell Resistance no (object)

DESCRIPTION

You cause the weapon to sprout vicious thorns and spikes. You must cast this spell on a weapon with a wooden striking surface, including ironwood weapons.

For the duration of the spell the weapon deals bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage and gains a +1 enhancement bonus for every three caster levels you possess. This stacks with any existing enhancement bonus up to +5.
